{{Quote|Paak attended a separatist meeting two years ago in Jondora where he met a woman who said that if he was serious about politics, he might like to act as a liaison for Ferrix when he returned home.|Dedra Meero, to Bix Caleen|<ref name="Nobody's Listening">{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}}</ref>}}
'''Jondora''' was a terrestrial [[planet]]<ref name="Trivia Gallery" /> in the [[Jondora system]] of the [[Taris sector/Legends|Taris sector]], a subsector of the [[Ojoster sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="Appendix" /> where the salyard boss [[Salman Paak]] attended a separatist meeting<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> in [[7 BBY]].<ref name="7 BBY">{{AndorDate|109}} The episode establishes that [[Salman Paak]] visited Jondora two [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events. Therefore, Salman visited Jondora in [[7 BBY]].</ref> At the meeting, Paak met a [[Unidentified woman (Salman Paak)|woman]] that convinced him to act as a liaison for<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> his planet,<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Ferrix]], upon his return. Paak was thus provided with a [[fractal radio]] unit that he and the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Bix Caleen]] used to stay linked to a shadowy [[Axis network|anti-Imperial network]]. Paak was caught for it during the Empire's [[Ferrix occupation|occupation of Ferrix]], and after some interrogation, he retold his encounter on Jondora for [[Dedra Meero]], a [[ISB Supervisor|supervisor]] in the Empire's [[Imperial Security Bureau]].<ref name="Nobody's Listening" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jondora was first mentioned in "[[Nobody's Listening!]],"<ref name="Nobody's Listening" /> the ninth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of [[Tony Gilroy]]'s live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''. The episode was directed by [[Toby Haynes]] and aired on [[November 2]], [[2022]].<ref name="S1 Companion">{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}}</ref> Originating in [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, the astronomical object [[Jondora/Legends|Jondora]] was first mentioned in "Profiteering," a Slicing Crew Skill mission in [[BioWare]]'s [[2011]] multiplayer online roleplaying game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|Profiteering}}</ref>
